the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

```
import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])   # this instance's own log: the folder keeps every earlier one's
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
```

open('programs/task-23573144.py','w').write('''def transform(g):
    import collections
    bg = collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,0)]
    rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    obj=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    mir=[list(reversed(row)) for row in obj]
    zc=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==0]
    zr0=min(c[0] for c in zc); zc0=min(c[1] for c in zc)
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    for i,row in enumerate(mir):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            out[zr0+i][zc0+j]=v
    return out
''')
